name: Correlación de Fonemas
mechanism:
This method analyzes phoneme-visual correlation for deepfake detection:

1. **Audio Fonema Extracción**: The audio track is processed to extract a phoneme sequence with precise temporal alignment. Each phoneme is identified with its onset-offset timestamps and confidence score using speech recognition.

2. **Visual Fonema (Viseme) Detección**: The corresponding visual phoneme (viseme) sequence is extracted from lip/jaw motion analysis. Key visemes include: bilabial closure (/m/, /p/, /b/), labiodental (/f/, /v/), dental (/θ/, /ð/), and open vowels (/a/, /o/).

3. **Fonema - Viseme Temporal Correlación**: The temporal alignment between audio phonemes and visual visemes is measured. In authentic speech, audio leads visual by ~50ms (auditory-visual speech lag). The method computes cross-correlation to check this temporal relationship. Deepfakes may show incorrect timing between audio and visual speech.

4. **Articulation Completeness**: Certain phonemes require specific visual articulations that are physiologically mandatory — /m/ requires complete lip closure, /f/ requires lip-teeth contact. The method checks whether mandatory articulations are achieved. Deepfake lip generators may fail to produce complete target articulations.

5. **Co - Articulation Patrón Verificación**: In natural speech, phoneme production is influenced by surrounding phonemes (anticipatory and carry-over coarticulation). The method checks for natural coarticulation effects in the visual speech signal. AI-generated lip movements often lack proper coarticulation, producing discrete viseme transitions.
parameters:
Tipo de análisis: sensor
Medio: video
Entrada: Video frames extracted at key intervals
Salida: Puntuación de confianza (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: Moderada a Alta — 70-88% precisión independiente. Most effective when combined with other video forensic methods. Performance depends on video quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detección de deepfake y video generado por IA mediante phoneme correlation analysis. Este método examina características temporales y espaciales que son difíciles de replicar perfectamente por sistemas de IA, proporcionando evidencia para la evaluación de autenticidad del video.
strengths:
• Captura artefactos temporales que el análisis de cuadro único pierde
• Funciona con formatos de video estándar
• Efectivo contra técnicas comunes de deepfake
• Se puede combinar con otros métodos forenses de video
• Basado en investigación establecida de visión por computadora
limitations:
• Rendimiento afectado por la compresión y resolución del video
• Algunos métodos requieren suficiente cantidad de cuadros para el análisis temporal
• La efectividad varía según la técnica de generación de deepfake
• Se usa mejor como parte de un pipeline integral de múltiples métodos
• Puede producir falsos positivos en videos auténticos con edición intensiva

references.title: Haliassos, A. et al. (2021). Lips Don't Lie: A Generalisable and Robust Approach To Face Forgery Detection. CVPR.
Chugh, K. et al. (2020). Not Made for Each Other — Audio-Visual Dissonance-based Deepfake Detection. ACM MM.
